method: 150 lines sampled (stratified by kind: 40 event_title, 40 event_why, 25 strike_title, 15 dataset_field, 8 strike_target, 8 era_label, 8 series_label, 6 series_note; seed 7) and read in full: 5 wrong, 4 minor (in_sample=true). Corpus-wide scans of all 15,195 pairs: no missing/empty/duplicate hashes; numbers/dates match source (no digit mismatches found); place-name check of 532 'Israeli ... on <village>' strike titles against research/geo/gazetteer.jsonl added the other findings (in_sample=false). Terminology (UNIFIL, STL, SLA, BDL, Hezbollah, IDF) is consistent.
